concept_dna.canonical: A load-bearing woven or interlaced leather-strip lattice creates directional flexibility and support as an authentic part of the footwear structure.
concept_dna.rationale: The structural lattice and its directional behavior distinguish the concept; literal full-surface coverage does not.

concept_dna.canonical: The functional monk strap remains continuous with and structurally integrated into the interlaced lattice.
concept_dna.rationale: The closure-to-lattice relationship is the distinctive construction idea.

hard_constraints.canonical: The product remains footwear and recognizably uses a functional adjustable monk-strap closure.
hard_constraints.rationale: Removing category or functional closure creates another product.

hard_constraints.canonical: The lattice must carry or transfer structural load and connect credibly to the shoe chassis; it cannot be a printed, embossed, appliqued, or decorative overlay.
hard_constraints.rationale: Structural participation prevents conventional footwear with superficial grid styling.

design_variables.permitted: Concentrate the lattice in selected load-bearing upper zones and use explicit structural anchors into a quieter sole or chassis.
design_variables.prohibited: Removing structural lattice participation or reducing it to surface decoration.
design_variables.proposed: Use a graded lattice at the instep and quarters with controlled anchor points into a refined solid sole, leaving calmer toe and heel fields.

design_variables.dimension: cell geometry, density, strip scale, and transitions
design_variables.permitted: Vary cell size, orientation, density, strip width, and transition rhythm while retaining genuine interlacing.
design_variables.prohibited: Replacing interlacing with a printed grid or unrelated perforation pattern.
design_variables.proposed: Graduate from a tighter structural weave near the strap and instep to larger, quieter cells toward transition zones.

design_variables.dimension: last, toe, heel, sole, and overall proportion
design_variables.permitted: Substantially refine proportions and negative space while retaining footwear and monk identity.
design_variables.prohibited: Changing category or eliminating the monk closure.
design_variables.proposed: Use an elongated narrow last, low sculpted heel, and disciplined sole thickness with deliberate negative space.

design_variables.permitted: Rebalance calfskin, linen, Onyx Black, and Butter Yellow by structural role.
design_variables.prohibited: Using materials only as implausible texture or claiming tested comfort.
design_variables.proposed: Make Onyx calfskin dominant; reserve linen and Butter Yellow for tension-bearing interlaces and precise touchpoint accents.

concept_dna.canonical: Rigid leather rings form a reconfigurable skeleton while one continuous leather element binds them into a flexible skin.
concept_dna.rationale: The ring-skeleton and continuous binding relationship defines the purse.

concept_dna.canonical: Changing how many rings are engaged mechanically changes capacity and silhouette.
concept_dna.rationale: User-controlled ring engagement is the transformation principle.

hard_constraints.canonical: The product remains a functional small leather good capable of carrying contents.
hard_constraints.rationale: It must remain a purse rather than sculpture.

hard_constraints.canonical: At least one continuous strap must pass through and bind functional rigid rings; rings cannot be ornamental appliques.

design_variables.dimension: ring count, scale, spacing, section, and engagement
design_variables.permitted: Vary ring hierarchy and engagement sequence while retaining reconfiguration.
design_variables.prohibited: Fixed decorative rings with no structural transformation.
design_variables.proposed: Use fewer, more precisely graduated rings with controlled overlaps and a clear transformation path.

design_variables.permitted: Redesign cylinder, basket, tote, or clutch proportions as states of one mechanism.
design_variables.proposed: Resolve a compact vertical clutch state and a broader low basket state with one continuous visual identity.

design_variables.dimension: leather finish, color hierarchy, and hardware visibility
design_variables.permitted: Rebalance blue, yellow, and metal while clarifying load paths.
design_variables.proposed: Use deep polished blue rings, a restrained yellow binding line, and nearly invisible precision hardware.

concept_dna.canonical: A blazer has shoulder structures suspended from the collar rather than fixed conventionally to the body.
concept_dna.rationale: Mobile suspended shoulders define the concept.

concept_dna.canonical: Movement changes tension and shoulder position, shifting the silhouette between structured and draped states.
concept_dna.rationale: Responsive suspension is the behavioral innovation.

hard_constraints.canonical: The product remains a wearable tailored blazer with functional collar, lapel, body, and arm movement.
hard_constraints.rationale: It cannot become an installation or cape.

hard_constraints.canonical: Shoulder elements remain physically suspended and movement-responsive, not merely oversized conventional padding.
hard_constraints.rationale: This protects the mechanism from decorative substitution.

design_variables.dimension: cord visibility, anchor placement, shoulder travel, and tension
design_variables.permitted: Vary suspension exposure and travel range while preserving real movement response.
design_variables.prohibited: Concealing a fixed shoulder under fake cords.
design_variables.proposed: Use minimal visible silk tension lines at deliberate collar anchors with controlled shoulder drift.

design_variables.dimension: box volume, shoulder scale, lapel proportion, and body length
design_variables.permitted: Substantially rebalance tailoring proportions around the mobile perimeter.
design_variables.prohibited: Eliminating blazer identity or arm function.
design_variables.proposed: Use a long lean body with a restrained floating shoulder perimeter and sharply edited independent lapels.

design_variables.permitted: Use contrast to clarify suspended versus grounded components.
design_variables.prohibited: Suggesting impossible weightlessness or validated durability.
design_variables.proposed: Keep matte olive wool quiet; concentrate charcoal quilted silk on mobile shoulder elements with tonal cords.

concept_dna.canonical: Four removable structural panels assemble around a central tensioned core to alternate between rigid briefcase and flat-folder states.
Panels slide on and are tensioned by the central core rather than folding as a conventional soft bag.
concept_dna.rationale: Sliding/tension engagement is the construction innovation.

hard_constraints.canonical: The product remains a functional bag/briefcase capable of carrying and protecting contents.
All four functional panels must engage one real central structural core and support reversible rigid and flat states.

design_variables.dimension: panel proportion, thickness, corner treatment, and spacing
design_variables.permitted: Refine panel geometry and junction gaps while retaining four-panel assembly.
design_variables.prohibited: Replacing panels with one conventional gusseted shell.
design_variables.proposed: Use four exceptionally thin goatskin planes with controlled shadow gaps and softened precision corners.

design_variables.dimension: core placement, visibility, tension, and release detailing
design_variables.permitted: Reveal or conceal portions of the core while making its operation legible.
design_variables.proposed: Expose the central core only at top and base interfaces through refined tension hardware.

design_variables.permitted: Substantially rebalance height, width, handle, color blocks, and trim.
design_variables.prohibited: Changing bag category or transformation states.
design_variables.proposed: Use a tall, slim architectural brief in deep electric blue with restrained white edge punctuation.

concept_dna.canonical: Extreme-bias fabric panels create a skirt whose textile structure stretches and rotates around the legs in motion.
concept_dna.rationale: Bias-driven kinetic rotation defines the garment.

concept_dna.canonical: A continuous spiral assembly anchored at a stable waistband converts walking motion into changing tension and silhouette.
concept_dna.rationale: The anchored spiral is the operative mechanism.

hard_constraints.canonical: The product remains a wearable skirt with a secure waist and usable leg movement.
hard_constraints.rationale: It cannot become an abstract textile installation.

hard_constraints.canonical: Bias orientation, spiral continuity, and waistband anchoring must remain functional construction rather than printed spiral graphics.

design_variables.dimension: panel width, spiral pitch, seam rhythm, density, and directional emphasis
design_variables.permitted: Vary spiral geometry while preserving continuous bias-driven motion.
design_variables.prohibited: Replacing construction with surface print or static pleating.
design_variables.proposed: Use a graduated spiral with broader quiet upper panels and increasingly expressive lower rotation.

design_variables.dimension: length, tube width, flare, slit, and movement volume
design_variables.permitted: Redesign static and moving proportions while remaining a wearable skirt.
design_variables.prohibited: Changing category or blocking leg movement.
design_variables.proposed: Resolve a long lean column at rest that opens into controlled asymmetric volume during stride.

design_variables.dimension: silk weight, surface, waistband hierarchy, and yellow/white balance
design_variables.permitted: Rebalance material and palette to clarify motion and anchoring.
design_variables.prohibited: Claiming tested tension durability or comfort.
design_variables.proposed: Use luminous off-white silk as the field, a restrained Butter Yellow kinetic edge, and a quiet leather anchor band.
